sys_atf_test.description: GET /api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=<valid> must answer HTTP 200 with exactly the three whitelisted keys. The whitelist is asserted negatively as well: the body must not contain assigned_group, assigned_agent, description, closed_date, requester_name, requester_email, sys_id. The call is made with no credentials at all. Each returned value is compared to the stored value exactly - status, subject AND opened_date - so a response carrying a different case's data, a placeholder or a reformatted date fails. Because lookupCase() resolves the number with setLimit(1) and no orderBy, step 1 also VERIFIES that exactly one row carries the pinned number CASE9000019 and that the row is its own fixture, so the lookup cannot resolve to a foreign record. Verification, never enforcement by deletion: a row this test does not own - one carrying that number, or occupying the fixture sys_id without this test subject marker - fails the test, is named in the failure message and is left exactly as it was found.
